open_questions.question: Does the full Eq (20)+(22) angular-sum conductivity reproduce the same spectral lineshape off-resonance as the near-resonance closed forms Eq (25)/(26) used here?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The closed forms assume Omega*tau0 >> 1 and omega ~ Omega. Off-resonance the full angular-harmonic sum could diverge from the Lorentzian approximation, affecting the wings of the Faraday spectrum in Fig. 2/3.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Implement the full conductivity sum and compare theta_F(omega) over the whole scanned grid to the Eq (26) curve.

open_questions.question: Do the parabolic-dispersion (bilayer/2DEG) formulas Eq (21)/(23)/(24) yield the same order-of-magnitude 0.1 deg / 0.1 T as the graphene case?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The paper claims generality across linear and parabolic spectra; only the linear/graphene branch was coded here, leaving half the paper's headline scope unverified.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Code the parabolic effective-mass conductivity and evaluate theta_F, B_syn for a representative 2DEG (e.g. GaAs) at matched Omega*tau1.

open_questions.question: Is theta_K approx -theta_F an adequate substitute for the independent Kerr evaluation via Eq (6) at the n1=1, n2=3 dielectric contrast?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The Kerr angle carries the reflection Fresnel factors; at finite (not infinite) contrast theta_K may deviate from -theta_F by a non-negligible factor, changing the Kerr headline number.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Evaluate Eq (6) directly with the substrate Fresnel coefficients and compare to -theta_F.

open_questions.question: How sensitive is the peak Faraday angle to the choice tau0/tau1 ratio, and does the paper's Fig. 3 assume tau0 = 5 ps or 10 ps?
open_questions.why_it_matters: theta_F and B_syn scale with tau0; the 2x ambiguity (5 vs 10 ps) between Fig. 3 params and the paper's explicit B_syn estimate propagates directly into the headline agreement (0.044 vs 0.1 deg).
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Digitize Fig. 3 axis labels/caption to pin the exact tau0, tau1, eps_F used, and re-evaluate.

open_questions.question: Does a pixel-level digitization of Figs. 2-4 confirm the resonance peak position and width predicted by Eq (26)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Cross-checks match the paper's stated scalar numbers, but no figure-level curve comparison was done; the resonance width (set by tau0) is untested against the plotted lineshape.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Digitize the Fig. 3 theta_F(omega) curve and overlay the Eq (26) prediction on the same axes.
